service.en: Training and work permit for students
service.ur: طلبہ کے لیے تربیت اور ورک پرمٹ

about: Let a student aged 15 or over train or work at a registered establishment.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Student is 15 or older and holds no valid work permit
Job is not on the juvenile prohibited list, apart from skill levels 1 and 2
Establishment has a valid licence with no violations
Applied for by the establishment's authorised signatory
documents: Clear colour photo on a white background
Valid residence visa for non-national students
Guardian's written consent for students under 18
Medical certificate of fitness for the job
No-objection certificate from the school for training
Contract signed by employer and student
fees: Business centres may add a commission of up to 72 AED
Otherwise free on the website and app; tax and collection charges are extra
